# Pluribus results (generated by src/analyze_pluribus.py)

Data check: 10,000 hands, 10,000 with a result, 0 failing the zero-sum check.

## Raw win rate vs. the published AIVAT estimate

| Estimate | Win rate (bb/100) | Std. error | 95% interval |
|---|---|---|---|
| Raw results, 10,000 hands | -7.09 | 8.81 | -24.36 to 10.19 |
| Published (AIVAT) | 4.80 | 2.50 | -0.10 to 9.70 |

Raw standard deviation: 88.1 bb/100.
Raw results would need about 124,315 hands to be as precise as the AIVAT estimate, roughly 12.4x the sample.
